name: zmath_unproject_point_batch
description: zMath::UnprojectPointBatch converts projected screen x/y plus reciprocal z into view-space points using the cached inverse projection globals.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x474bc0 validates the count gate, reciprocal-z inversion, and x/y unprojection through g_zMath_ProjOffsetX/Y and g_zMath_InvProjScaleX/Y.
The native zmath projection batch smoke verifies the unprojected x/y/z result for a projected point.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x474bc0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath projection pass.
